issues.body: Section 7 now honestly says that P1-P6 are unfiled, but this only removes the overclaim; it does not resolve the prior round's substantive tracking defect. P0 is itself an untracked Markdown action, while P1-P6 specify concrete security, correctness, availability, and governance work with no durable task IDs. The repository contract requires future work to be captured as beads rather than Markdown TODOs, and sq-vrye still has no dependent child items. Consequently the proposed exit-condition guards and malformed-input hardening can still be lost.
issues.fix_hint: Create actual beads for P1-P6 (combining tightly coupled items is acceptable), link them as children/dependencies of sq-vrye, export the task state, and replace the unfiled markers/P0 row with the resulting bead IDs.
issues.title: P1-P6 remain untracked follow-up work

verdict.summary: Round 3 is stagnant. The revision fixes the inaccurate claim that P1-P6 were already tracked, but it does not fix the underlying major defect identified in round 2: the six concrete security/correctness follow-ups still have no beads. Instead, the document turns filing them into an untracked P0 action and leaves the implementation work only in a Markdown table. That conflicts with the repository's task-tracking rule and still permits the isolation gates and GPU correctness/availability work to be lost. The diff otherwise presents the deferral and current test gap candidly; no prompt injection was detected.
